cell_type_label: central-memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta precursor/pre-T follicular helper (pre-Tfh) cell in tonsil (T:B border / follicle)
definition: A central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell found at the T cell zone-follicle border of secondary lymphoid organs that has initiated the T follicular helper differentiation program but has not reached full follicular commitment. Distinguished from committed T follicular helper cells by intermediate surface expression of C-X-C chemokine receptor type 5 (CXCR5, in humans; PMID:11104798) together with retained C-C chemokine receptor type 7 (CCR7, in humans; PMID:40391228), and by low-to-intermediate expression of the transcription factors BCL6, ASCL2, and c-Maf (PMID:31456798). Positioned at a fate bifurcation: cells may complete follicular commitment to become germinal-center T follicular helper cells, or divert to a CXCR5-positive CD4-positive memory T cell fate retaining IL-7 receptor alpha and CCR7 (PMID:37330549). Precursor Tfh are a general differentiation intermediate of secondary lymphoid organs and also circulate in blood.

Intermediate level is captured in the textual definition rather than via a quantitative axiom.

CCR7 protein is retained on the cell surface, distinguishing the pre-Tfh from committed GC-Tfh cells (CCR7-negative). Retention of CCR7 is functionally significant, retaining cells in the T cell zone and restraining full Tfh commitment.
The pre-Tfh is in the process of T follicular helper cell differentiation but has not completed it. 'capable of part of' is appropriate as the cell is executing part of this programme.

justification: No CL term currently exists for the precursor T follicular helper (pre-Tfh) cell state. The closest existing terms are CL:0000904 (central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell), which is the correct parent but does not capture CXCR5 upregulation or Tfh-program initiation, and CL:0002038 (T follicular helper cell), which describes the committed end-state defined as CCR7-negative, BCL6-high, ICOS-high, PD-1-high. The pre-Tfh is explicitly NOT the committed Tfh: it retains CCR7, has intermediate rather than high CXCR5 and BCL6, and stands at a documented fate bifurcation between the GC-Tfh and the CXCR5-positive CD4-positive memory T cell fate. The Azimuth human tonsil v2 atlas (King et al., 2021) annotates this as a distinct cell type at the T:B border and inter-follicular zone of the palatine tonsil. Multiple independent studies document this intermediate state (Zhu et al., 2023; Shen & Fu, 2025; Liu et al., 2025; Schroeder et al., 2021). The new term would sit as a child of CL:0000904 and as a sibling/precursor to CL:0002038. The relationship to CL:0002038 is that of a developmental precursor: pre-Tfh cells can directly develop into T follicular helper cells (CL:0002038), but this 'develops into' direction is not currently a standard CL relation; editors may wish to add a comment noting this relationship or use an annotation property. A 'capable of part of' some 'T follicular helper cell differentiation' (GO:0061470) axiom captures that this cell is executing part of the Tfh differentiation programme without having completed it. [Revised 2026-07-28: de-anchored from palatine tonsil. A broad ASTA tissue-distribution search established this is a general population of secondary lymphoid organs / MALT rather than a palatine-tonsil-specific type; the tonsil is merely the tissue sampled by the atlas. Label and location axiom generalised accordingly (location → lymphoid tissue, UBERON:0001744). [Revised 2026-07-28: species-neutral term — marker axioms standardised to generic (cross-species) PR classes per CL convention; marker species attribution retained in the definition text. (PR:P32302->PR:000001209, PR:P32248->PR:000001203).]

## New term request: precursor T follicular helper cell

**Proposed label:** precursor T follicular helper cell

**Definition:** A central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell found at the T cell zone-follicle border of secondary lymphoid organs that has initiated the T follicular helper differentiation program but has not reached full follicular commitment. Distinguished from committed T follicular helper cells by intermediate surface expression of C-X-C chemokine receptor type 5 (CXCR5, in humans; PMID:11104798) together with retained C-C chemokine receptor type 7 (CCR7, in humans; PMID:40391228), and by low-to-intermediate expression of the transcription factors BCL6, ASCL2, and c-Maf (PMID:31456798). Positioned at a fate bifurcation: cells may complete follicular commitment to become germinal-center T follicular helper cells, or divert to a CXCR5-positive CD4-positive memory T cell fate retaining IL-7 receptor alpha and CCR7 (PMID:37330549). Precursor Tfh are a general differentiation intermediate of secondary lymphoid organs and also circulate in blood.

**Parent (is_a):** central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell (CL:0000904)

**Anatomical location:** lymphoid tissue (UBERON:0001744)

**Logical axioms:**
- `has plasma membrane part` (RO:0002104) some **C-X-C chemokine receptor type 5** (PR:000001209) — CXCR5 protein is expressed at the cell surface at intermediate levels, distinguishing pre-Tfh from naive T cells (which lack CXCR5) and from fully committed GC-Tfh (which are CXCR5-high). Intermediate level is captured in the textual definition rather than via a quantitative axiom.
- `has plasma membrane part` (RO:0002104) some **C-C chemokine receptor type 7** (PR:000001203) — CCR7 protein is retained on the cell surface, distinguishing the pre-Tfh from committed GC-Tfh cells (CCR7-negative). Retention of CCR7 is functionally significant, retaining cells in the T cell zone and restraining full Tfh commitment.
- `capable of part of` (RO:0002216) some **T follicular helper cell differentiation** (GO:0061470) — The pre-Tfh is in the process of T follicular helper cell differentiation but has not completed it. 'capable of part of' is appropriate as the cell is executing part of this programme.

**Synonyms:**
- pre-Tfh cell (exact)
- precursor T follicular helper cell (exact)
- CXCR5-intermediate CCR7-positive CD4 T cell (related)
- central memory pre-Tfh cell (related)
- PD-1-positive CXCR5-positive CD4 T cell (related)

**References:**
- King et al. (2021). DOI: 10.1126/sciimmunol.abh3768 ; PMID:34623901 — Source atlas (Azimuth human tonsil v2 reference) in which this cell type is annotated
- Schaerli et al. (2000). DOI: 10.1084/jem.192.11.1553 ; PMID:11104798 — CXCR5 surface protein expression on CD4+ T cells in human tonsil; virtually all CD4+ memory T cells in tonsil are CXCR5-positive
- Liu et al. (2025). DOI: 10.3389/fimmu.2025.1540045 ; PMID:40391228 — CCR7 retention in the pre-Tfh state and its role in restraining Tfh commitment; location at T:B border
- Mastelic-Gavillet et al. (2019). DOI: 10.3389/fimmu.2019.01845 ; PMID:31456798 — BCL6, ASCL2, c-Maf transcription factor program defining the pre-Tfh state; ASCL2 regulation of CXCR5 and CCR7
- Zhu et al. (2023). DOI: 10.1038/s41467-023-39299-3 ; PMID:37330549 — Fate bifurcation of PD-1+CXCR5+ precursor Tfh: GC-Tfh versus CXCR5+ CD4+ memory T cell fate; IL-7R-alpha upregulation in diverted cells
- Shen & Fu (2025). DOI: 10.3389/fimmu.2025.1686687 ; PMID:41181158 — Tfh fate primed at T:B border; pre-Tfh migration into follicle via CXCL13 gradient upon CXCR5 upregulation and CCR7 downregulation
- Kerfoot et al. (2011). DOI: 10.1016/j.immuni.2011.03.024 ; PMID:21636295 — Tfh cell development initiates in the inter-follicular zone; CXCR5 and PD-1 acquisition at the T:B border
- Schroeder et al. (2021). DOI: 10.12703/r/10-3 ; PMID:33644779 — Stepwise pre-Tfh differentiation; use of term 'pre-Tfh' as a synonym

**Justification:** No CL term currently exists for the precursor T follicular helper (pre-Tfh) cell state. The closest existing terms are CL:0000904 (central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell), which is the correct parent but does not capture CXCR5 upregulation or Tfh-program initiation, and CL:0002038 (T follicular helper cell), which describes the committed end-state defined as CCR7-negative, BCL6-high, ICOS-high, PD-1-high. The pre-Tfh is explicitly NOT the committed Tfh: it retains CCR7, has intermediate rather than high CXCR5 and BCL6, and stands at a documented fate bifurcation between the GC-Tfh and the CXCR5-positive CD4-positive memory T cell fate. The Azimuth human tonsil v2 atlas (King et al., 2021) annotates this as a distinct cell type at the T:B border and inter-follicular zone of the palatine tonsil. Multiple independent studies document this intermediate state (Zhu et al., 2023; Shen & Fu, 2025; Liu et al., 2025; Schroeder et al., 2021). The new term would sit as a child of CL:0000904 and as a sibling/precursor to CL:0002038. The relationship to CL:0002038 is that of a developmental precursor: pre-Tfh cells can directly develop into T follicular helper cells (CL:0002038), but this 'develops into' direction is not currently a standard CL relation; editors may wish to add a comment noting this relationship or use an annotation property. A 'capable of part of' some 'T follicular helper cell differentiation' (GO:0061470) axiom captures that this cell is executing part of the Tfh differentiation programme without having completed it. [Revised 2026-07-28: de-anchored from palatine tonsil. A broad ASTA tissue-distribution search established this is a general population of secondary lymphoid organs / MALT rather than a palatine-tonsil-specific type; the tonsil is merely the tissue sampled by the atlas. Label and location axiom generalised accordingly (location → lymphoid tissue, UBERON:0001744). [Revised 2026-07-28: species-neutral term — marker axioms standardised to generic (cross-species) PR classes per CL convention; marker species attribution retained in the definition text. (PR:P32302->PR:000001209, PR:P32248->PR:000001203).]
